error_codes.doc: The game cannot run the request yet; `detail.reason` says why (see not_ready_reasons).
An in-flight cap was reached (the plugin-wide one, or one bridge connection's); retry later.
The message is malformed: wrong field types, missing or unknown op, bad arguments, nesting deeper than max_json_depth, a duplicate in-flight id on one bridge connection.
The script or function does not exist in the running game.
A value has the wrong Papyrus type or is out of range (Int outside 32 bits, Float outside 32-bit range).
A runtime-created reference no longer names the object it was handed out for (fingerprint mismatch).
A form, alias, quest or property does not exist.
The call did not finish within its timeout_ms (or the caller stopped waiting first: detail.late_cancel is true). It may still run in the game.
The Papyrus VM refused or failed the call.
The request is valid protocol but this plugin build cannot do it.
A bug or an unexpected failure inside the plugin; never caused by the caller alone.
Wrong token. Usually a stale session file from an earlier game run.
Client and plugin speak different protocol major versions.

limits.name: max_frame_bytes
limits.doc: Dev bridge: largest frame payload either side accepts. A larger header closes the connection.

limits.name: pre_auth_frame_bytes
limits.doc: Dev bridge: frame cap until the hello is accepted; a valid hello is well under 1 KiB.

limits.name: max_name_bytes
limits.doc: Longest script, function, property or editor_id string.

limits.name: max_batch_calls
limits.doc: Most calls in one papyrus.batch (the least is 1).

limits.name: max_timeout_ms
limits.doc: Largest timeout_ms; also the largest default_timeout_ms.

limits.name: max_error_message_bytes
limits.doc: Error messages are clipped to this many bytes, so a response can never exceed the frame limit.

limits.name: max_client_name_bytes
limits.doc: The hello's client name is truncated to this many bytes.

limits.name: max_connections
limits.doc: Dev bridge: simultaneous client connections; further ones are closed at accept.

limits.name: hello_timeout_ms
limits.doc: Dev bridge: a connection that has not sent an accepted hello by then is closed.

limits.name: max_json_depth
limits.doc: Deepest array/object nesting accepted in a request. In-process the request fails with bad_request; on the dev bridge the connection is closed.

limits.name: max_queued_bytes_per_connection
limits.doc: Dev bridge: outbound bytes queued for one connection before it is treated as a stuck reader and closed.

limits.name: token_length
limits.doc: Dev bridge: tokens are 128 random bits as lowercase hex.

limits.name: int_min
limits.doc: Smallest Papyrus Int. Out of range is type_mismatch, never truncation.

limits.name: int_max
limits.doc: Largest Papyrus Int; also the largest alias_id and the largest hello protocol number.

limits.name: float_max_text
limits.doc: Largest Papyrus Float magnitude, as the shortest text that round-trips FLT_MAX; a larger magnitude is type_mismatch.

limits.name: max_array_items
limits.doc: Most items in a Papyrus array (the VM's own limit); a longer array argument is type_mismatch.

config_keys.name: python_enabled
config_keys.doc: Start the embedded Python interpreter at kDataLoaded. Off means the plugin loads but runs no Python.

config_keys.name: scripts_enabled
config_keys.doc: Load player scripts from the scripts folder at startup.

config_keys.name: bridge_enabled
config_keys.doc: Run the dev bridge (loopback TCP for an external process). Off in the shipped ini, on in the dev ini.

config_keys.name: port
config_keys.doc: Dev bridge TCP port on 127.0.0.1; 0 picks a free port.

config_keys.name: fixed_token
config_keys.doc: Development only: a fixed 32-hex bridge token. Empty means a random token per start.

config_keys.name: session_file
config_keys.doc: Where the bridge writes its session file. Empty means <SKSE log dir>/Skython/session.json.

config_keys.name: default_timeout_ms
config_keys.doc: Timeout applied to a call that sends none.

config_keys.name: max_inflight_per_connection
config_keys.doc: Requests one dev-bridge connection may have in flight.

config_keys.name: max_inflight_total
config_keys.doc: Requests in flight in the whole plugin (in-process and bridge together).

ops.name: game.state
ops.result: `{"data_ready","game_loaded","loading","interactive","paused":bool,"menus":[...],"epoch":n,"player":<form reference or null>,"game_days_passed":float or null}`; player and game_days_passed are null unless a game is loaded.

ops.name: form.resolve
ops.doc: Name a form three ways; get back a form reference with its type and form key.

args.name: editor_id
args.doc: only where the game keeps editor ids

args.name: args
args.doc: arguments, in order; absent means none

args.name: require_unpaused
args.doc: refuse with not_ready while a menu pauses the game

ops.name: papyrus.call_method
ops.doc: Call a member function on a form or alias.

args.name: script
args.doc: the script type to bind, for example `Actor`

args.name: args
args.doc: arguments, in order; absent means none

args.name: require_unpaused
args.doc: refuse with not_ready while a menu pauses the game

ops.name: papyrus.batch
ops.doc: Run several papyrus.* steps in order in one round trip. Not a transaction.

args.name: stop_on_error
args.doc: stop at the first failed step

args.name: timeout_ms
args.doc: one timeout for the whole batch
